title: Build outputs collected as artifacts and downloaded with verified checksums
demonstrates: declared artifacts frozen after the main steps, before cleanup
files, a directory and a Unicode file name
a missing optional artifact is reported, not a failure
artifact_download verifies size and SHA-256 before placing the file
with a dedicated binding, artifacts are exported before the automatic stop and downloadable offline

steps.script:
set -e
mkdir -p dist/report reports
git archive --format=tar -o dist/app.tar HEAD
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, subprocess
# Deterministic 5 MiB: the downloaded bytes can be recomputed locally and compared exactly.
with open('dist/blob.bin', 'wb') as out:
    for i in range(163840):
        out.write(hashlib.sha256(b'blob-%d' % i).digest())
commit = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
files = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files'], text=True).splitlines()
with open('dist/app.tar', 'rb') as package:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(package.read()).hexdigest()
with open('dist/report/summary.json', 'w') as out:
    json.dump({'commit': commit, 'files': len(files), 'tarSha256': digest}, out, indent=2)
with open('dist/report/files.txt', 'w') as out:
    out.write('\n'.join(files) + '\n')
with open('dist/报告 notes.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as out:
    out.write('构建于 ' + commit + '\n')
print('built', commit)
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json
summary = json.load(open('dist/report/summary.json'))
assert summary['tarSha256'] == hashlib.sha256(open('dist/app.tar', 'rb').read()).hexdigest(), 'summary does not match package'
with open('reports/junit.xml', 'w') as out:
    out.write('<testsuite name="artifact-demo" tests="1" failures="0"><testcase name="summary-matches-package"/></testsuite>\n')
print('summary matches package')
PY
